source: Derived from the October 5 inventory, with a narrow October 9 compatibility correction from the October 7 shape-preserving synthetic per-org replica (SHA-256 cf3c8cb7a831a254578abe1e02e62475ba7d42fe08a7c109924633626b430717). review: Header names only: the body is no longer held to an observed per-field shape. tools/tee-native/inventory.mjs refuses before reveal any response header name not listed here and any credential in the body, meaning a non-empty string under a credential-named key or a string in a known credential format. The complete body is disclosed only inside the measured enclave, and the schema's selector and checks judge every field a decision reads. Set-Cookie values remain hidden; HTTP/1.1 framing headers are allowed. This supersedes the October 9 correction that admitted six observed non-null Claude settings.
